title: Squirrel waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d="M50 80 Q75 95 88 70 Q95 45 78 32 Q65 22 58 40 Q52 55 60 65 Q65 72 55 78 Z" fill="#E8622C"/>
  <path d="M55 78 Q70 88 80 72 Q88 55 78 42 Q70 33 64 45 Q58 58 63 66" fill="#F28C42" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx="45" cy="72" rx="18" ry="16" fill="#C9561E"/>
  <!-- Belly -->
  <ellipse cx="43" cy="75" rx="11" ry="11" fill="#F6C48A"/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="48" r="16" fill="#D96526"/>
  <!-- Ear left -->
  <ellipse cx="30" cy="34" rx="5" ry="7" fill="#C9561E" transform="rotate(-15 30 34)"/>
  <ellipse cx="30" cy="35" rx="3" ry="4" fill="#F6C48A" transform="rotate(-15 30 35)"/>
  <!-- Ear right -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="34" rx="5" ry="7" fill="#C9561E" transform="rotate(15 50 34)"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="35" rx="3" ry="4" fill="#F6C48A" transform="rotate(15 50 35)"/>
  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx="34" cy="46" r="4" fill="#2D1B0E"/>
  <circle cx="33" cy="45" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- Cheek -->
  <ellipse cx="28" cy="52" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#F28C42" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- Muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx="28" cy="54" rx="6" ry="5" fill="#F6C48A"/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <circle cx="24" cy="53" r="2" fill="#5C2E0E"/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d="M24 55 Q26 58 29 56" stroke="#5C2E0E" stroke-width="1" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Front leg (on body) -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="85" rx="6" ry="5" fill="#C9561E"/>
  <!-- Foot -->
  <ellipse cx="35" cy="90" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#D96526"/>
  <!-- Waving arm raised -->
  <path d="M52 65 Q65 52 72 38" stroke="#C9561E" stroke-width="7" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Waving paw -->
  <circle cx="73" cy="35" r="6" fill="#F6C48A"/>
  <!-- Paw fingers -->
  <circle cx="69" cy="30" r="2.5" fill="#F6C48A"/>
  <circle cx="74" cy="28" r="2.5" fill="#F6C48A"/>
  <circle cx="79" cy="30" r="2.5" fill="#F6C48A"/>
  <!-- Wave lines -->
  <path d="M82 26 Q86 24 86 28" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M84 33 Q88 34 87 37" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M80 22 Q81 19 84 20" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Acorn held in other paw -->
  <ellipse cx="56" cy="76" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#8B5A2B"/>
  <path d="M52 73 Q56 69 60 73" fill="#A0743C"/>
  <line x1="56" y1="69" x2="56" y2="66" stroke="#8B5A2B" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
